title: H2O: Just Add Water: Metamorphosis
overview: Three teenagers Cleo, Emma and Rikki become mermaids after discovering a Moon Pool on Mako Island. The girls must learn how to control their new powers and hide their secret. 90-minute edit of episodes 1, 2, 3, 4, 8 & 12 of the Australian TV series ‘H2O: Just Add Water’.
